result.instructions: Tools for TrackingMore, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of my registered parcels have been delivered recently?"; "What is the current status of tracking number 1Z999AA10123456784?"; "Which courier does tracking number 9400111899223344556677 belong to?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes TrackingMore data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run trackingmore_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run trackingmore_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run trackingmore_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. trackingmore_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: trackingmore_list_couriers
tools.title: List supported couriers
tools.description: List the carriers TrackingMore supports with their courier_code, name, country, website, phone and the extra fields some of them need. The full list is long (1,000+), so filter with `search` (matches name or code) and/or `country`; replies hold at most `limit` couriers. GET /couriers/all.

search.description: Case-insensitive text in the courier name or code, e.g. 'dhl'.

country.description: Courier country, ISO 3166 alpha-2, e.g. US.

tools.name: trackingmore_detect_courier
tools.title: Detect courier from a tracking number
tools.description: Find which couriers a tracking number most likely belongs to (returns matching courier codes and names). Use the code with trackingmore_create_tracking. Does not create anything. POST /couriers/detect.

tools.name: trackingmore_list_trackings
tools.title: List trackings
tools.description: List the shipments already registered in the TrackingMore account, newest first as the API returns them: id, tracking number, courier, delivery_status (pending, notfound, transit, pickup, delivered, undelivered, exception, expired, inforeceived), latest event and milestone dates. Checkpoint lists are left out (use trackingmore_get_tracking for one shipment's full history). Filters: tracking numbers, courier, delivery status, created/updated date range. GET /trackings/get.

tracking_numbers.description: One to 40 tracking numbers, comma-separated (TrackingMore refuses more than 40 per call).

courier_code.description: TrackingMore courier code, e.g. usps, ups, dhl (see trackingmore_list_couriers / trackingmore_detect_courier).

delivery_status.description: pending, notfound, transit, pickup, delivered, undelivered, exception, expired or inforeceived.

archived_status.description: Archive filter: true = archived trackings, tracking = trackings that are not archived.

created_date_min.description: A date (yyyy-mm-dd, taken as 00:00:00 UTC) or an ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00 or 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. Sent to TrackingMore as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM.

created_date_max.description: A date (yyyy-mm-dd, taken as 00:00:00 UTC) or an ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00 or 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. Sent to TrackingMore as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM.

updated_date_min.description: A date (yyyy-mm-dd, taken as 00:00:00 UTC) or an ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00 or 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. Sent to TrackingMore as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM.

updated_date_max.description: A date (yyyy-mm-dd, taken as 00:00:00 UTC) or an ISO 8601 date-time with a timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00 or 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z. Sent to TrackingMore as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM.

lang.description: Language for status text, e.g. en.

page.description: Page number, from 1 (default 1). Sent as pages_amount.

limit.description: Trackings per page, 1-200 (default 40). Sent as items_amount.

tools.name: trackingmore_get_tracking
tools.title: Get a shipment's tracking
tools.description: The full tracking record of one shipment already registered in the account, including every checkpoint (origin_info / destination_info trackinfo with date, status, details and location). Look it up by tracking number; add courier_code if the number is used by several couriers. A number that was never registered is not found: register it with trackingmore_create_tracking first. GET /trackings/get?tracking_numbers=.

courier_code.description: TrackingMore courier code, e.g. usps, ups, dhl (see trackingmore_list_couriers / trackingmore_detect_courier).

lang.description: Language for status text, e.g. en.

tools.name: trackingmore_create_tracking
tools.title: Register a shipment for tracking
tools.description: WRITE: register ONE shipment so TrackingMore starts tracking it. This uses one credit of the account's plan (credits beyond the plan are billed by TrackingMore as overage): confirm with the user before creating, and never create trackings in bulk. Fails with 'Tracking No. already exists' if it is already registered. Needs the tracking number and the courier code (use trackingmore_detect_courier if unknown). Some couriers need extra fields (postal code, ship date, key). Returns the new tracking with its id. POST /trackings/create.

courier_code.description: TrackingMore courier code, e.g. usps, ups, dhl (see trackingmore_list_couriers / trackingmore_detect_courier).

order_number.description: Your order number for this shipment.

order_id.description: Your order id in the shop system.

customer_email.description: Recipient email (TrackingMore can send delivery notifications to it when enabled in the account).

customer_sms.description: Recipient mobile number, with country code.

label.description: Label to group shipments. It must be a label you created in the TrackingMore dashboard first, otherwise TrackingMore refuses it (meta 4131).

language.description: Language code for status text, e.g. en.

tracking_origin_country.description: Origin country for couriers that need it, ISO 3166 alpha-2.

tracking_destination_country.description: Destination country for couriers that need it, ISO 3166 alpha-2.

tracking_postal_code.description: Recipient postal code (needed by some couriers).

tracking_ship_date.description: Ship date, yyyymmdd (needed by some couriers).

tracking_key.description: Tracking key / phone suffix (needed by some couriers).

tools.name: trackingmore_update_tracking
tools.title: Update a tracking's details
tools.description: WRITE: change the descriptive fields of a registered tracking (order number, customer name/email, title, note, label, language, postal code, ship date ...). Only the fields you pass change; the tracking number and courier cannot be changed here. PUT /trackings/update/{id}.

id.description: TrackingMore tracking id (the `id` field of a tracking from trackingmore_list_trackings or trackingmore_create_tracking).

order_number.description: Your order number for this shipment.

order_id.description: Your order id in the shop system.

customer_email.description: Recipient email (TrackingMore can send delivery notifications to it when enabled in the account).

customer_sms.description: Recipient mobile number, with country code.

label.description: Label to group shipments. It must be a label you created in the TrackingMore dashboard first, otherwise TrackingMore refuses it (meta 4131).

language.description: Language code for status text, e.g. en.

tracking_origin_country.description: Origin country for couriers that need it, ISO 3166 alpha-2.

tracking_destination_country.description: Destination country for couriers that need it, ISO 3166 alpha-2.

tracking_postal_code.description: Recipient postal code (needed by some couriers).

tracking_ship_date.description: Ship date, yyyymmdd (needed by some couriers).

tracking_key.description: Tracking key / phone suffix (needed by some couriers).

tools.name: trackingmore_delete_tracking
tools.title: Delete a tracking
tools.description: WRITE (destructive): permanently remove one tracking from the TrackingMore account by id. Its checkpoint history is lost; registering the shipment again later uses another credit. Confirm with the user first. DELETE /trackings/delete/{id}.

id.description: TrackingMore tracking id (the `id` field of a tracking from trackingmore_list_trackings or trackingmore_create_tracking).
